name: DFW 2012 to 2016 two-story under the 2009 IRC
description: Texas moved to the 2009 IRC energy chapter in 2012. Two-story production housing, slab, vented attic, low-e windows, R-6 to R-8 attic flex, first era with duct testing in practice. The plan's 2000 to 2015 bucket covers this era; the tighter end of each range is used. Inspect and override.

era.code_basis: 2009 IRC energy provisions statewide from 2012 until the 2015 IRC/IECC took effect in September 2016 (SECO, DOE).

style.typical_cladding: brick veneer with stone or siding accents

sources.citation: RhoeFlow plan v2, Era-based defaults for DFW table (claude/01-plan/research-and-plan.md); estimates to seed the questionnaire
Texas SECO, single-family energy code history: 2009 IRC from 2012
DOE Building Energy Codes Program, Texas adoption status

ceiling_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Upper end of the 2000 to 2015 bucket for the 2009 IRC years. Replace with the measured depth.

window_ufactor.basis: Low-e double-pane vinyl; tighter end of the plan range. An NFRC sticker replaces this.

window_shgc.basis: Low-e glazing; tighter end of the plan range.

air_leakage.basis: Tighter end of the plan range for the 2009 IRC years. A blower-door result replaces this.

duct_insulation_r.basis: R-6 attic flex per the plan bucket; R-8 appears in this era and should be read from the jacket label.

duct_leakage_to_outside.basis: Tighter end of the plan bucket, read as total to outside. Needs served floor area to become CFM25 (WO-02 derivation); recorded as skipped until then.
